requirements.name: Passport Index Data (imorte/passport-index-data), scraped from passportindex.org
requirements.note: Per passport and destination: visa free (days where known), visa on arrival, ETA, e-visa, visa required, no admission. The dataset does not say how days are counted (per entry or per window); data/visa-curated.json adds that where sourced.

validity.name: UK FCDO foreign travel advice, entry requirements (GOV.UK content API)
validity.note: Written for British passports. Passport-validity rules are set by the destination and usually apply to every passport.

ES.quote: Spain follows Schengen area rules. Your passport must: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it might have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago, making it invalid for entry to the Schengen area have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue)

PT.quote: Portugal follows Schengen area rules. Your passport must: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it might have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago, making it invalid for entry to the Schengen area have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue)

NG.quote: To enter Nigeria, your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

ER.quote: To enter Eritrea, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank consecutive pages for stamping.

CI.quote: To enter Côte d’Ivoire, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

SZ.quote: To enter Eswatini, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps.

CL.quote: Your passport should have an ‘expiry date’ after the day you plan to leave Chile.

PL.quote: Poland follows Schengen area rules. Your passport must have: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it might have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago, making it invalid for entry to the Schengen area an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue)

KE.quote: To enter Kenya, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages.

CM.quote: To enter Cameroon, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

PE.quote: To enter Peru, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

NP.quote: To avoid problems at immigration, make sure your passport has an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after your date of entry into Nepal. Checks at border control At border control, you may need to show: a travel insurance document which has cover for healthcare costs including repatriation and other emergencies while you are in Nepal confirmation of where you will spend your first night, for example, a hotel booking

BW.quote: To enter Botswana, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 3 blank pages. Make sure you get your passport stamped. This will record your date and port of entry. Unstamped passports will raise suspicions of illegal entry.

UG.quote: To enter Uganda, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

BZ.quote: To enter Belize, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ more than 3 months after the date you arrive. Some airlines may refuse boarding if the expiry date is not more than 6 months after the date you arrive.

SA.quote: For entry into Saudi Arabia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. Previous travel to Israel You may not be allowed to enter Saudi Arabia if your passport shows that you have travelled to, or were born in, Israel.

NI.quote: To enter Nicaragua, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

GT.quote: To enter Guatemala, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages.

SV.quote: To enter El Salvador, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive.

HN.quote: To enter Honduras, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages. Check with your travel provider that your passport and other travel documents meet requirements. Renew your passport if you need to.

ZA.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 30 days after the date you leave South Africa and have at least 2 blank pages.

GH.quote: To enter Ghana, your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

BJ.quote: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

TG.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave Togo.

MD.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave Moldova, and at least one blank page.

TD.quote: To enter Chad, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

PY.quote: To enter Paraguay, your passport should be valid for the duration of your stay. Make sure you get your passport stamped. Make sure that an immigration official stamps, dates and signs your passport when you arrive. If you do not have an entry stamp in your passport, you will get a fine when you leave the country. This is important if you enter Paraguay at a land border, typically the crossing between Ciudad del Este and Foz do Iguaçu in Brazil. Long-distance bus drivers sometimes tell foreign nationals that they can complete immigration formalities in Asunción. This is not true, and you will get a fine if you do not get your passport stamped at the point of entry.

MG.quote: To enter Madagascar, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. It must also have at least 2 blank pages.

IT.quote: Italy follows Schengen area rules. Your passport must: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it might have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago, making it invalid for entry to the Schengen area have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue)

MN.quote: To enter Mongolia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

EC.quote: To enter Ecuador, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

ET.quote: Your passport must be: valid for at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Ethiopia machine-readable

US.quote: To enter the US, your passport must be valid for the length of your planned stay.

KZ.quote: To enter Kazakhstan, your passport must be valid for at least 30 days from the date you arrive and have at least one blank page.

TZ.quote: To enter Tanzania, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least one blank page.

UA.quote: If you’re travelling without a visa, your passport should be valid for the proposed duration of your stay. No additional period of validity beyond this is required. If you’re applying for a visa, your passport may need to have an additional period of validity. Check with the Ukrainian Embassy in the UK for further details. Additional requirements at the border At the border you will need to: complete an immigration card scan your fingerprints as part of biometric data collection at border crossing points if requested by the immigration officer have evidence of sufficient funds. You can show: cash

CO.quote: To enter Colombia, your passport must be valid on entry. However, Colombian immigration authorities recommend your passport has an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you plan to leave.

BR.quote: To enter Brazil, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

CY.quote: To enter Cyprus, your passport must have: a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it may have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue) at least one blank page for stamping

TR.quote: To enter Turkey, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 150 days after the date you arrive and at least 1 blank page.

YE.quote: To enter Yemen, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

JO.quote: To enter Jordan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

IQ.quote: To enter Iraq, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least one blank page.

BH.quote: To enter Bahrain, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

KW.quote: To enter Kuwait, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. Previous travel to Israel

PS.quote: To enter Israel or Palestine, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 90 days after the date you arrive.

IL.quote: To enter Israel or Palestine, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 90 days after the date you arrive.

PK.quote: To enter Pakistan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date of your visa application. Make sure you get your passport stamped on entry. Leaving Pakistan will be difficult if you do not have an entry stamp. If your passport was not stamped on entry, contact the Ministry of Interior or visit a National Database and Registration Office (NDRA) office. Illegal entry to Pakistan is a serious offence. If you enter without the correct documentation you may be detained or deported. If you enter Pakistan illegally, you may not be able to travel onward from Pakistan.

SY.quote: To enter Syria, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you arrive. Entry restrictions

IR.quote: If you choose to enter Iran against FCDO advice, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. It’s not possible to apply for a British passport from Iran. Previous travel to Israel

EG.quote: To enter Egypt, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least one blank page.

AE.quote: To enter the UAE, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

QA.quote: If you are visiting Qatar, your passport should be valid for at least 6 months from the date you arrive. You will be denied entry if you do not have a valid travel document or try to use a passport that has been reported lost or stolen.

OM.quote: To enter Oman, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

IN.quote: To enter India, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

CG.quote: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay. No additional period of validity is needed.

BF.quote: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay and have 2 blank pages for entry stamps.

SC.quote: If you’re visiting Seychelles, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

NE.quote: Your passport should be valid for the proposed duration of your stay. No additional period of validity is needed.

AZ.quote: To enter Azerbaijan as a visitor, your passport must usually have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps. See ‘visa requirements’ for more details. To enter Azerbaijan as a resident, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the expiry date of your temporary or permanent residence permit.

FR.quote: France follows Schengen area rules. Your passport must: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it might have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago, making it invalid for entry to the Schengen area have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave the Schengen area (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue)

RS.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 90 days after the date you plan to leave Serbia.

BD.quote: To enter Bangladesh, your passport must have at least 2 blank pages and no damage. See ‘Applying for a visa’ for passport validity requirements for visas. Make sure you get your passport stamped. Make sure you get an entry stamp in your passport when you arrive. Immigration officers will check the date on your entry stamp when you leave Bangladesh. You could get a fine for overstaying. At Bangladeshi border control, you may also need to show a return or onward ticket.

TM.quote: To enter Turkmenistan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you plan to leave Turkmenistan.

VE.quote: To enter Venezuela, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you plan to leave.

MW.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive in Malawi.

MX.quote: To enter Mexico, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay. The Mexican Embassy in the UK recommends passports be valid for at least 180 days because this is the longest you can stay in Mexico as a tourist.

MR.quote: To enter Mauritania, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

MU.quote: Your passport must: be valid for the duration of your stay have one blank page

AL.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave Albania.

KR.quote: To enter South Korea as a tourist for up to 90 days, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ after the date you are leaving South Korea. To enter South Korea on a long-term visa, your passport should have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

SN.quote: To enter Senegal, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

KH.quote: To enter Cambodia your passport must be: valid for at least 6 months from the date you arrive in Cambodia undamaged and complete – entry is normally refused if you have a damaged passport or pages missing

SB.quote: To enter the Solomon Islands, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps.

TH.quote: To enter Thailand, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 1 blank page.

PA.quote: If you are visiting Panama, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you plan to leave Panama.

CD.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive in DRC.

DZ.quote: To enter Algeria, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

RO.quote: Romania follows Schengen area rules. Your passport must have: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it might have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago, making it invalid for entry to the Schengen area an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave the Schengen area (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue) Carry your passport if you travel from Romania to other Schengen area countries. Border guards will check it if you cross land or river borders into Bulgaria or Hungary, both are in the Schengen area.

RU.quote: To enter Russia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date your visa expires. You cannot enter Russia using a visa in an expired passport, even if you’re also carrying a new, valid passport. You will need to apply for a new visa or visa transfer. Sign your passport before you travel if it was issued after January 2017. Some British nationals have been denied entry for not signing their passports. Traveling with children Children under 18 years old must carry a notarised travel permission from one of their parents or legal guardians if they’re travelling out of Russia without their parent or legal guardian.

HR.quote: Croatia follows Schengen area rules. BG.quote: Bulgaria follows Schengen area rules. Your passport must have: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it might have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago, making it invalid for entry to the Schengen area an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you plan to leave the Schengen area (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue) Carry your passport if you travel from Bulgaria to other Schengen area countries. Border guards may check it if you cross land or river borders into Greece or Romania, both in the Schengen area.

BA.quote: To enter Bosnia and Herzegovina, your passport must: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it may have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago have an ‘expiry date’ at least 90 days after the date you plan to leave

BY.quote: To visit Belarus, your passport must be valid for at least 3 months from the date you arrive.

AT.quote: Austria follows Schengen area rules. Your passport must: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it might have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago, making it invalid for entry to the Schengen area have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area (the expiry date does not need to be within 10 years of the date of issue)

AM.quote: If you are visiting Armenia, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

AD.quote: To travel to Andorra, you must follow the Schengen area passport requirements. Andorra is not in the Schengen area, but you must travel through a Schengen area country to reach Andorra, either France or Spain. Your passport must: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive – if you renewed your passport before 1 October 2018, it may have a date of issue that is more than 10 years ago have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

VN.quote: To enter Vietnam, your passport must have: an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive at least 2 blank pages no damage – British nationals have been denied entry and exit due to passport damage It is a requirement of Vietnamese authorities that visitors enter and exit Vietnam using the same passport. Make sure you get your passport stamped. Check the visa expiry date written in your passport is correct before leaving border control. If it is wrong, you could be accused of overstaying. Your passport is stamped upon entry which will specify the date by which you need to leave Vietnam.

VU.quote: To enter Vanuatu, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

UZ.quote: To enter Uzbekistan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you arrive.

TV.quote: To enter Tuvalu, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

TO.quote: To enter Tonga, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

TL.quote: To enter Timor-Leste, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have 2 blank pages.

TJ.quote: To enter Tajikistan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

TW.quote: To enter Taiwan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive. Arrival cards You must complete a Taiwan Arrival Card (TWAC) within three days before your arrival in Taiwan. This must be submitted online via the Ministry of the Interior National Immigration Agency website. You may be exempt if you hold a resident visa, Alien Resident Card (ARC), Alien Permanent Resident Card (APRC), or other permits issued by the Taiwanese authorities. For further advice and instructions on how to complete and submit the TWAC, check the National Immigration Agency.

LK.quote: To enter Sri Lanka, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive.

SG.quote: To enter Singapore, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ 6 months after the date you arrive.

WS.quote: To enter Samoa, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. Check with your travel provider that your passport and other travel documents meet requirements. Renew your passport if you need to.

PH.quote: To enter the Philippines, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

PG.quote: To enter Papua New Guinea, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

PW.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Palau and at least 2 blank pages.

KP.quote: Your passport should be valid for the proposed duration of your stay.

NZ.quote: To enter New Zealand, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave.

NR.quote: To enter Nauru, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you arrive.

MM.quote: To enter Myanmar, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive.

FM.quote: To enter the Federated States of Micronesia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 120 days after the date you arrive. You will need to clear immigration even for a domestic flight, so you will always need your passport when you fly in the FSM.

LB.quote: Your passport should be valid for at least 3 months from the date you enter Lebanon. Checks at border control

LY.quote: To enter Libya, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay. Previous travel to Israel

MA.quote: To enter Morocco, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the date you arrive. Make sure your passport is not damaged. The Moroccan authorities have denied entry to some travellers with damaged passports. Check with your travel provider that your passport and other travel documents meet requirements. Renew your passport if you need to. Lost or stolen passports

MH.quote: To enter the Marshall Islands, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and one blank page for an entry stamp.

MV.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least one month after the date you arrive in Maldives. Make sure your passport is not damaged or you may be stopped by immigration.

MY.quote: To enter Malaysia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. Make sure it is undamaged, with no pages missing.

AG.quote: To enter Antigua and Barbuda, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

MO.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 90 days after the date you leave Macao.

BS.quote: To enter The Bahamas, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you plan to leave.

BB.quote: Your passport must be valid for the planned length of your stay.

LA.quote: To enter Laos, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least 2 blank pages. Airlines will only let you board your flight if your passport has enough blank pages.

KG.quote: If you’re visiting or resident in Kyrgyzstan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive.

KI.quote: To enter Kiribati, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

CA.quote: To enter Canada, your passport must be valid for the length of your planned stay.

CR.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 1 day after the day you plan to leave Costa Rica.

CU.quote: To enter Cuba, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and 3 months after your planned departure date.

DM.quote: To enter Dominica, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

DO.quote: Up until 31 December 2026, British passport holders can enter and leave the Dominican Republic for tourism purposes, as long as their passport remains valid for the duration of their visit. Rules may change after this date. Check the Dominican Republic Ministry of Tourism website for the latest information. Checks at border control You may be refused entry if you do not have proof of onward or return travel when you arrive in the country. Border officials will take your fingerprints and take a photograph of you before allowing you into the country. Entry and exit form You must fill in an entry and exit form before arriving in and leaving the Dominican Republic. This form includes your:

GD.quote: To visit Grenada, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. Make sure you get your passport stamped. Make sure the border control officer puts a stamp in your passport. If you do not get a stamp in your passport, you’ll be considered an illegal visitor.

HT.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

JM.quote: To enter Jamaica, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay. You must have 2 blank pages for entry and exit stamps.

KN.quote: To enter St Kitts and Nevis, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

LC.quote: If you’re visiting St Lucia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ after the day you plan to leave. Make sure you get your passport stamped. Make sure the border control officer puts a stamp in your passport. Border guards will use passport stamps to check you have not stayed longer than you’re allowed.

VC.quote: To enter St Vincent and the Grenadines, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. Importing food Because of foot and mouth disease, you will need an import licence if you bring any food to the island.

TT.quote: To enter Trinidad and Tobago your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

AR.quote: To enter Argentina, your passport must be valid for the proposed duration of your stay. If you are a resident in Argentina, your passport must be valid for entry.

BO.quote: To enter Bolivia, your passport should have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least two blank pages.

JP.quote: If you’re visiting Japan, your passport must be valid for the length of your stay. No additional period of validity is required. You need a blank page for your visa stamp.

ID.quote: To enter Indonesia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

HK.quote: Your passport must be valid for at least one month after the date you plan to leave Hong Kong.

GY.quote: To enter Guyana, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. You will not be able to enter Guyana if you do not have a valid travel document or try to use a passport that has been reported lost or stolen.

FJ.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Fiji.

SR.quote: To enter Suriname, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. Arrival Report All travellers to and from Suriname are required to complete an Immigration and Customs Form [ICF] up to three days before arrival and departure.

UY.quote: To enter Uruguay, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay and have at least one blank page for an entry stamp.

AO.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Angola and have at least 2 blank pages.

BI.quote: To enter Burundi, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and have one blank page.

CV.quote: To enter Cape Verde, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

KM.quote: To enter Comoros, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

CF.quote: To enter the Central African Republic, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

DJ.quote: To enter Djibouti, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

GQ.quote: To enter Equatorial Guinea, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

CN.quote: To enter China, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and 2 blank pages for visas and stamping.

BN.quote: To enter Brunei, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. It must not be damaged or have any pages missing. If your passport does not meet these conditions, you may be refused entry and detained. You will be denied entry if you do not have a valid travel document or try to use a passport that has been reported lost or stolen.

BT.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you plan to leave Bhutan.

GA.quote: Your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ that is at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Gabon.

GM.quote: To enter The Gambia, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

GN.quote: To enter Guinea, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

GW.quote: To enter Guinea-Bissau, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

AU.quote: To enter Australia, your passport must be valid for the length of your planned stay.

AF.quote: If you decide to travel to Afghanistan against FCDO advice, check with your travel provider whether your passport and other travel documents meet requirements.

LS.quote: To enter Lesotho, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 90 days after the date you arrive. Make sure you get your passport stamped. You need at least 4 blank pages for passport stamping. Lesotho border control need to stamp your passport and so do South African border control on your way to and from Lesotho.

LR.quote: To enter Liberia, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

ML.quote: To enter Mali, your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

MZ.quote: To enter Mozambique, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. Make sure you get your passport stamped with the correct dates before leaving the immigration desk. You need at least 2 blank pages for entry stamps.

NA.quote: To enter Namibia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. It must also have at least 3 blank pages. If you’re travelling to Namibia through South Africa read the South Africa travel advice.

RW.quote: To enter Rwanda, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive and at least one blank page for entry stamps.

ST.quote: Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay.

SL.quote: To enter Sierra Leone, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date of your visa application.

SO.quote: To enter Somalia, including Somaliland, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

SS.quote: To enter South Sudan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the day you arrive and have at least 2 blank pages.

SD.quote: To enter Sudan, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

TN.quote: To enter Tunisia, your passport should be valid for the duration of your stay. Damaged or torn passports

ZM.quote: To enter Zambia, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive. It must have at least 2 blank pages for entry stamping. Make sure you get your passport stamped. Dual nationality When returning to the UK, British citizens must carry a valid British passport or certificate of entitlement. See Dual citizenship. Zambia recognises dual nationality. However, to avoid delays at the airport you should leave Zambia on the same passport you used to enter.

ZW.quote: To enter Zimbabwe, your passport must have: an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive 3 blank pages, in case you need to enter Zimbabwe and exit through one of the neighbouring countries or if you need to leave at short notice
